The FuelPhysique toolkit

Plan your next step. Keep track of what follows.

Build a routine, plan meals and keep a record of what you do. Choose a tool below to see the actual workflow before signing in.

Choose where to start

Workout planning

Build your workout plan for the gym or home.

Starting with three gym days a week, or a pair of dumbbells at home? Choose your training days, available equipment, goal and experience. Generate a routine with exercises, sets, reps and rest times, then review it before you train.

Explore workout planning →

Meal planning

Plan one day of meals, with portions, calories and protein.

Turn your food preferences into a personalized one-day meal plan. See what to prepare, ingredient quantities for each serving and estimated calories and protein for each meal and the day. Choose your dietary style and meal count, then review or replace meals before saving.

Explore meal planning →

Food diary

Log your food. See what is left.

Keep an editable food log with estimated calories, protein, carbs and fat. With an active nutrition plan, see your daily targets and remaining amounts alongside what you have logged.

Explore food diary →

Workout tracking

Bring your plan to the session. Keep the record.

Open a session from your active plan, follow the exercises and record completed sets. A built-in rest timer helps you move through the workout; saved history keeps the session available afterward.

Explore workout tracking →

Weekly training volume

See where your weekly training sets go.

Look beyond a long exercise list. FuelPhysique summarizes planned weekly work by muscle group, using direct sets and fractional contributions from exercises that involve multiple muscles.

Explore weekly training volume →

Progress tracking

Keep a history, not just a single measurement.

Record dated body-weight measurements, review your recent trend and keep body measurements together. Add private progress photos only if they are useful to you.

Explore progress tracking →

Explore first. Save when you are ready.

Workout and meal planning forms are open to explore. Sign in when you generate or save a plan. The food diary includes a three-entry guest trial. Account-based tracking keeps your saved history separate from public feature pages.
